evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never frames the 10-15 minute time box or promises a dependable quote before diving into logistics. Jumps directly to 'I was just calling in regards to your online booking for October 2nd. Do you have about five to ten minutes' — no quid pro quo framing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks 'do you have any specific concerns or questions about the move that you'd like answered on this call today?' but after discovery basics have already started (name/email/phone confirmed). Customer declines concerns, citing friend's referral.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer states 'Not really. As I had a friend who had used Einstein a few weeks ago and kinda ran me through everything' — no concerns raised, therefore N/A.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No concerns were raised by customer, therefore N/A.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep covers: property type (storage unit and condo), floor/stories (4th floor storage, 2nd floor condo), unit size/square footage (10x10 storage, 800 sq ft condo), rooms (2 bedrooms), ceiling type (Florida ceiling), special items (couch, mattress, TV in box, glass boxes), fragile items (TV, glass boxes), access/parking distance (20 feet to elevator, 2 doors with 1 potentially broken), stair vs elevator access (stairs at destination). Nearly all seven logistics items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep never asks 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?' Not offered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep never asks about typical box count or overflow check. Not asked.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep states 'the system quoted you at about three hours and 45 minutes which I think that you would fall within that range' — gives a range but does not personalize it to customer-specific factors (their stated concerns, prep level, added services). Partial.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep delivers pricing structure: 'We just charge the hourly rate. Everything is included in the hourly rate, fuel and trucks taxes, insurance... and all tools for disassemble and reassembly' and mentions 'no deposit.' Does not explicitly mention trip fee, overnight fee, packing materials upfront, or the 2.5-hour-minimum / 15-minute-increments commitment. Partial.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent. Not asked.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep delivers: 'we do have our on time guarantee we value your time. So, if we can't make in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill' — covers discount terms in recognizable form. Full.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep delivers: 'we do have our no worries, damage coverage. Which is our free evaluation coverage included in the hourly rate provides up to $2,000 per move to repair replace or reimburse for accidental damages' — covers $2,000 coverage and 'included in the hourly rate' (not an add-on). Does not explicitly frame as 'no deductible / no fine print' but states it's included in rate. Partial (missing explicit no-deductible framing).
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent check. Does not close the loop on Two Promises.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks 'Do you have any other questions for me?' — empty throwaway phrasing, not genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' version.
evidence_quotes.followup_on_remaining_concern: Customer raises two items: (1) 'The exact address for the condo, the unit is 211 which I forgot to add-on there' and (2) 'if in the next week I needed to move the time or change the time rather. How could I do that.' Rep acknowledges both but does not dig deeper with 'tell me more about that' — addresses them directly. Not a genuine follow-up dig but factual concern handling.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' Not asked.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' Closes call with 'Thank you so much for your time and speaking with me and then we will see you Friday October 2nd.' No explicit ask; assumes booking. Never asked.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep states 'Yes, there's no deposit obviously do get on our schedule so there's no risk and steering in that spot and there's no changes, no fees are charges for changes' — no-deposit mentioned, satisfying rate-lock intent. True.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Rep confirms: October 2nd date, 8:39 AM (later mentioned 8:30), condo address 500 East Riverside Drive Austin TX 78704 Unit 211, phone 229-944-0262, email T.edge42@outlook.com. Missing: crew size, final arrival window confirmation (8:30 vs 8:39 ambiguity left), notes left for crew about customer's concerns (broken door, fragile items). Partial.

top_strength: Brianne gathered comprehensive logistics details on both the storage unit and destination condo, including ceiling type, special items, fragile goods, access constraints, and parking distance—all the probing essentials for an accurate move estimate.
coaching_note: Never deliver a quid pro quo frame, skip the explicit ask for business entirely, and omit active concern discovery and Two Promises close—this call worked only because the customer had a friend's prior experience and assumed the booking was confirmed; without that, the rep lost the sale.
